dimensions.assessment: Affects oil and gas operators filing new permit applications on public lands and the Bureau of Land Management.
dimensions.evidence: collect a fee for each new application for a permit to drill

dimensions.assessment: Extends an existing fee collection and fund transfer mechanism for an additional eleven years without altering the underlying regulatory framework.
dimensions.evidence: transfer, for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2037, all of the fees collected under this subsection... to the BLM Permit Processing Improvement Fund

dimensions.assessment: Continues fee collections and subsequent transfers to the permit processing fund through FY2037.
dimensions.evidence: extend the period of time during which the Secretary of the Interior is required to collect a fee for each new application for a permit to drill

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Mineral Leasing Act to change expiration dates from 2026 to 2037 for permit processing fees.
dimensions.evidence: Section 35(d) of the Mineral Leasing Act (30 U.S.C. 191(d)) is amended--(1) in paragraph (1), by striking '2026' and inserting '2037'

dimensions.assessment: Extends the fee collection authority and fund transfers for an 11-year period through fiscal year 2037.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2037

missing_information: Expected annual revenue generated by the permit processing fees
Total number of permit applications anticipated per year
importance_detail.rationale: The bill extends through fiscal year 2037 the Bureau of Land Management's authority to collect oil and gas permit processing fees and transfer them to the BLM Permit Processing Improvement Fund.
